item: Finite-law pair bound (Lemma lem:pair-bound): k(H(ν) − H⁰_ρ(ν)) ≤ log|kF| + C_k Σ_{2^{-ℓ} ≤ 2ρ} c_ℓ(ν), log-free and independent of the minimal separation of F = supp ν
lean_status_why: pair_bound_natural states Lemma 3.2 with the paper's constant C_k = 60000 k^4 (natural-log form) and is on the proof DAG of all three comparator theorems; pair_bound (SumsetBound.lean:329) is the base-2 restatement.
lean_gaps: Checked at text level only; the Lean was not compiled.

The shortlist's pointer pair_bound (SumsetBound.lean:329) is a base-2 wrapper and is NOT on any comparator DAG (0 dependents). The load-bearing declaration is pair_bound_natural (:269), which states the same inequality in natural log, with the factor Real.log 2 moved onto the capacity term.
Law is a finitely supported real law with strictly positive weights (prob_pos), as in the paper.
The paper's C_k is existential, with the remark that one may take 60000 k^4; Lean hard-codes 60000 k^4.
Downstream, exists_band_pair_bound replaces log|kF| by n·|α|·log(k+1) (a type-counting bound) for block laws; this is the paper's use, not a weakening of the lemma.
Dominated share in the comparator DAG: pair_bound_natural 0.10, exists_fine_partition 0.076 (extract_lean.py).

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law
lean_source.text:
structure Law where
  support : Finset ℝ
  prob : ℝ → ℝ
  prob_pos : ∀ x ∈ support, 0 < prob x
  prob_sum : ∑ x ∈ support, prob x = 1

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.capacity
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def capacity (ν : Law) (ℓ : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {t : ℝ | ∃ w : ν.edges ℓ → ℝ, Feasible w ∧ ∑ e, w e = t}

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.bandSupport
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def Law.bandSupport (ν : Law) : Finset ℤ := by
  classical
  exact (ν.support ×ˢ ν.support).image (fun e => bandIndex |e.2-e.1|)

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.sumset
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def Law.sumset (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) : Finset ℝ := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.image (fun x : Fin k → ν.support => ∑ i, (x i : ℝ))

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.refinementCost
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def Law.refinementCost (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (352*k^4/R)*ν.bandCost R*Real.log 2

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.exists_fine_partition
lean_source.text:
theorem exists_fine_partition (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → List ℤ,
      (∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, g a = g b → |a-b| ≤ ρ/4^J) ∧
      ν.partitionEntropy k g ≤ ν.partitionEntropy k (fun x => [⌊x/ρ⌋]) +
        ∑ h ∈ Finset.range J, ν.refinementCost k (ρ/4^h)

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.pair_bound_natural
lean_source.text:
theorem pair_bound_natural (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    k * (entropy ν.support ν.prob - observableEntropy ν.support ν.prob (fun x => ⌊x/ρ⌋)) ≤
      Real.log (ν.sumset k).card + 60000*k^4*Real.log 2 *
        ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ), capacity ν ℓ

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.pair_bound
lean_source.text:
theorem pair_bound (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    k*(ν.shannonEntropy-ν.gridEntropy ρ) ≤ Real.log (ν.sumset k).card / Real.log 2 +
      60000*k^4 * ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ), capacity ν ℓ

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.coupling_band_le_capacity
lean_source.text:
theorem coupling_band_le_capacity {ν : Law} (ℓ : ℤ) (π : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, 0 ≤ π x y)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, π x y = π y x)
    (hrow : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support, π x y ≤ ν.prob x) :
    (∑ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support,
      if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ |y - x| ∧ |y - x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ)
      then π x y else 0) ≤ capacity ν ℓ

lean_source.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Typed.exists_band_pair_bound
lean_source.text:
theorem exists_band_pair_bound (S : System α) (tag : α → β)
    (hr : ∀ a v, tag a=tag v → S.ratio a=S.ratio v)
    (A : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : ℤ, bandStart A n ≤ B ∧ ∀ w : Fin n → α,
      (k : ℝ)*entropyLoss S tag w (fineScale A n) ≤
        (n : ℝ)*Fintype.card α*Real.log (k+1)+60000*k^4*Real.log 2*
          ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Icc (bandStart A n) B, capacity (law S tag w) ℓ

speedup_targets.title: Single-scale entropy-to-pair-mass bounds (Varjú JAMS 2019, Prop. 21 with Lemma 27)
speedup_targets.statement: If a finitely supported law has entropy that is not visible at scale r, then a definite mass of it decomposes into fair two-point laws at distances in [r/2, 2r] (single scale, doubling hypothesis, log loss).
speedup_targets.reference: P. Varjú, On the dimension of Bernoulli convolutions for all transcendental parameters, Annals 189 (2019); and JAMS 2019 (arXiv:1602.00261), §4.2.3, Prop. 21.
speedup_targets.how_item_helps: A one-band specialization of the pair bound with k = 1 or 2 (the pair bound is log-free and multiscale, so it implies the single-scale version up to constants).
speedup_targets.expected_speedup: high but uninformative: the target is weaker than the item

speedup_targets.title: Kittle–Kogler entropy loss under addition, d = 1 (variance-energy form)
speedup_targets.statement: For finitely supported laws, the entropy lost when passing to k-fold sums is at most C·k·(multiscale variance energy); KK 2026 Thm 1.3 with C_m = 120 m².
speedup_targets.reference: S. Kittle, C. Kogler, arXiv:2610.10511 (7 Oct 2026), Thm 1.3; the proof is credited to GPT-6 Astra.
speedup_targets.how_item_helps: The pair bound gives the same shape with capacities and C_k = 60000 k^4. Proving KK's form needs only a capacity-versus-variance-energy comparison. Measures whether the library's version transfers to the competitor currency.

precedent_check.earlier_equivalent: no (Varjú Prop. 21 is a single-scale, log-lossy relative)
precedent_check.summary: Varjú (JAMS 2019, Prop. 21) converts entropy into fair-pair mass at a single scale, with a doubling hypothesis and log loss; the pair capacity is equivalent to his extremal decomposition (N1 for the definition). The log-free, separation-free, all-finer-scales pair bound has no earlier equivalent found. AFTER Oct 6: Kittle–Kogler, arXiv:2610.10511 (7 Oct 2026), proved the same mechanism with a variance-energy currency and C_m = 120 m², crediting GPT-6 Astra (first proof dated 27 Sep 2026), and called their Thm 1.3 a quantitative version of 148's Lemma 3.2. That is an independent, near-simultaneous rediscovery by another model: strong evidence the device is discoverable (Test 4 adverse).
